baseline_accounting.comparison: same corpus, tokenizer, batch, steps, optimizer family, and evaluation; shared_K1 and shared_K4 are near-parameter-matched but not FLOP-matched; shared_K4 and untied_K4 have equal nominal block FLOPs but different unique parameter storage; no claim is simultaneously iso-parameter and iso-FLOP.

flops_approximate.formula: 2*(2d)*(m*d) + K*(4*2*m*d*d + 2*m*m*d + 2*m*m*d + 2*m*d*4*d + 2*m*4*d*d) + 2*(m*d)*V; excludes embedding lookup, RMS rsqrt, softmax, and memory traffic

recurrence_ablation.primary_decision: shared_K4 depth is useful only if normal minus anchor_reset test NLL >= 0.01 nats/token with paired bootstrap 95% CI excluding 0 and normal shared_K4 beats shared_K1 by >=0.05 nats/token; otherwise stop depth claim.
variants: anchor_reset: before each r>0 set S^(r)=A_t
state_shuffle: permute batch state before each r>0

decision: Build one minimal causal recurrent workspace LM pilot; do not add external retrieval, learned halting, hidden-state teacher alignment, or quantization in this unit.

evaluation_protocol.autonomous_diagnostic: free-running generation without teacher at inference, report repetition rate, distinct-2, length completion, and human/error sample review; diagnostic only
evaluation_protocol.physical_decision: measure wall-clock tokens/s, peak RSS, cache/DRAM counters when available, and logical bytes separately; no estimate may be labeled measurement
primary: test next-token NLL and perplexity under true prefixes
student maintains its own S_t^K between tokens
report CE and KD divergence separately
evaluation_protocol.quality_decision: predeclare paired document bootstrap intervals, no T7-style exact 139/139 criterion
evaluation_protocol.recurrence_decision: use predeclared ablations above before inspecting outcomes
state_stress: evaluate processed lengths 32,64,128,256,512 and report NLL degradation relative to length 32

logical_components: per-round Q/K/V, attention, mixed/update/candidate buffers, depth and gate
buffers.training_note: B_intermediates is an inference live-buffer upper bound; autograd/checkpoint memory is separate and must be measured during the authorized pilot.

new_required: training data pipeline and KD loss
a fused CPU implementation for this exact block if PyTorch/BLAS is insufficient
reusable: CNRL scalar/AVX2 vector dot/GEMM contracts after FP32 correctness is established

kernels.warning: An existing int8 T0 kernel does not validate attention, RMSNorm, Prelude, or the complete OMEGA block.

physical_contract.latency_formula: T_total = T_entrada + T_core + T_head + T_estado + T_overhead

parameters.note: P_core is one UpdateBlock including slot mixing, CoreMLP, and update RMSNorm; untied_K4 has 4 P_core blocks.

physical_contract.traffic_rule: logical bytes calculated from tensors are distinct from physical DRAM traffic; absent counters do not turn estimates into measurements
physical_contract.vocab_rule: full V=50257 head is intentionally retained for first correctness pilot; selective vocabulary cost is recorded but not optimized until measurements justify it.

budget.checkpointing: short truncated-BPTT windows only; no full conversational BPTT
budget.student_memory: FP32 parameter totals below; optimizer/activation overhead must remain within cap and be measured in future execution

question: Minimum trainable CPU/RAM-compatible shared core that processes a matrix workspace and emits causal language without an external bank or teacher at inference.

reuse_map.demonstrated_function: State [B,S,D] -> shared slot mixing -> CoreMLP -> gated residual -> RMSNorm; shared variant stores one CoreMLP and reuses it across rounds; tests cover shapes, gradients, and shared/untied parameterization.
reuse_map.limitation: State-only core: no token Prelude, persistent token loop, language head, or general text objective. Reuse as Update block, not as complete LM.

reuse_map.demonstrated_function: Residual/replaced workspace accumulator with length masking and returned intermediate states.
reuse_map.limitation: Single vector workspace and round-indexed evidence; no multi-slot content mixing or vocabulary readout.

reuse_map.demonstrated_function: T0-R shared-depth reuse, T0-M slot matrixization, T0-RM real double-buffered recurrence; scalar/AVX2 kernel registry, fixed-point/group-RMS/global-RMS transitions, shared/clone physical controls. Existing report references shared/Bclone separation ~2260x in one D=1472 configuration.
reuse_map.limitation: CNRL is not an LM and has no tokenizer, language loss, attention proof, normalization proof for this student, or physical result for d=128/m=8. An int8 kernel does not validate a new attention/normalization/block implementation.

reuse_map.demonstrated_function: Approved executor operations, state/register transitions, and frozen 32-value decoder/codebook paths.
reuse_map.limitation: Learned transformations and decoder rely on catalog/harness-specific 32-value semantics. The 32-value decoder is not a general LM head and controller success is not language evidence.

reuse_map.demonstrated_function: A frozen-core binder scores role queries over token candidates, selects a candidate or NULL, and reads values through shared W_v plus approved decode_states path.
reuse_map.limitation: Four semantic queries and controlled 32-value lexical grammar. It is a later workspace/binding interface candidate, not the OMEGA recurrent language workspace and must not be relabeled as one.

student_specification.anchor: A_t is the token-local anchor and is reused by every round; no learned global anchor in v0
causal_graph: (E[x_t], S_{t-1}^K) -> concat(E[x_t], mean_slots(S_{t-1}^K)) -> Prelude -> A_t in R^(m x d)
for r=0..K-1: (S_t^(r), A_t, e_r) -> SlotMix(S_t^(r)+A_t) -> shared CoreMLP -> gated residual -> RMSNorm -> S_t^(r+1)
S_t^(K) is the only recurrent state transmitted to token t+1; reset is zeros for a new sequence
student_specification.depth: Fixed K=1 versus K=4 only; learned halting is deferred until useful fixed-depth work is demonstrated.

dimensions.dtype_first_pilot: FP32; Q8/Q4 deferred until a separate accumulated-error study

student_specification.normalization: RMSNorm without bias, epsilon 1e-6, after Prelude and after each residual update; no quantization scale in this unit
student_specification.prelude: token embedding E[x_t] in R^d concatenated with mean over previous full workspace S_{t-1}^K in R^d, Linear(2d,m*d), then RMSNorm(m*d), reshape to [m,d]
student_specification.readout: Flatten [m,d] to m*d, RMSNorm(m*d), dense Linear(m*d,V) full vocabulary head; no selective vocabulary optimization in pilot
student_specification.real_recurrence: Round r+1 receives the tensor produced by round r. Re-running a frozen transformation on A_t or summing repeated costs without consuming S_t^(r) is explicitly rejected as non-recurrence.
student_specification.reuse_choice: Wrap/recompose existing T1 SlotMix, CoreMLP, and RMSNorm into a token Prelude + persistent-state shell rather than cloning a Transformer or treating RecurrentCore as a complete LM.
student_specification.slots: Latent slots are generic workspace addresses; no FLOOR/AVOID/MATCH/ANCHOR assumptions and no T7 grammar dependency.
student_specification.strict_causality: Forward at t receives only x_t and S_{t-1}^K; target x_{t+1}, future tokens, teacher states, resolved semantic attributes, and external lookup are absent from the forward
student_specification.update: SlotMix uses T1 single-head Q/K/V over all m slots; add A_t before mixing so Update consumes both current state and anchor; shared CoreMLP is Linear(d,4d)->GELU->Linear(4d,d) per slot; apply per-round e_r in R^d; gate g_r=sigmoid(gate_logits[r]) per dimension; S=RMSNorm(S+g_r*update)
student_specification.weight_sharing: K=4 shared uses one literal UpdateBlock object containing SlotMix, CoreMLP, and RMSNorm; only depth embeddings and gate vectors vary by r and are separately counted. Untied control has four distinct UpdateBlock objects.
student_specification.write_gate: Per-dimension sigmoid gate, initialized near 0.1; gate parameters are per-round modulation and counted outside P_core

six_contract_tests: literal shared weights plus separate modulation
